messages.content: You are a helpful assistant that rewrites GNU C++14 code into functionally equivalent variants. The code reads and writes I/O from the console.

samples.content:
<perturbed_code_1>
#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
const int mod = 1e9 + 7;
int p, k;

int mu(int x, int y)
{
    if (y == 1) return x;
    int tmp = mu(x, y / 2);
    tmp = (1ll * tmp * 1ll * tmp) % mod;
    if (y % 2 == 0) return tmp;
    return (1ll * tmp * 1ll * x) % mod;
}

int main()
{
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(NULL);cout.tie(NULL);

    cin >> p >> k;

    if (k == 0)
    {
        cout << mu(p, p - 1);
        return 0;
    }

    if (k == 1)
    {
        cout << mu(p, p);
        return 0;
    }

    int m = 1;
    int t = k;
    while (1)
    {
        m++;
        t = (1ll * t * 1ll * k) % p;
        if (t == 1)
        {
            cout << mu(p, (p - 1) / m);
            return 0;
        }
    }

    return 0;

}

/*
x + 2 * y = n
x + y = k
*/
